title: Flagship comparison: iPhone 18 Pro vs Galaxy S26 Ultra (US, read 20 Oct 2026)

pages.supports: iPhone 18 Pro display, weight, camera, video playback
Galaxy S26 Ultra display, weight, camera, video playback
Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB price (the overview page shows a lower promotional from-price)

recommendation: Choose the iPhone 18 Pro for value and endurance: at 256GB it costs $200.99 less and is rated for 36 versus 31 hours of video playback. Choose the Galaxy S26 Ultra for its larger 6.9-inch display and 200 MP main camera. Samsung's overview page advertised a lower promotional from-price; this workbook uses the 256GB price on its buy page.
